topic: rebooking and service-room operations for salons and spas

products.name: Rebooking Recovery List
products.product: A focused salon and spa rebooking follow-up workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent salons, spas, and small wellness studios
products.problem: Clients who leave without a next appointment disappear into broad marketing lists even when the provider knows the right return window and service context.
products.valueProposition: Turns salon and spa rebooking follow-up into a visible operating queue so every eligible client receives a timely, contextual rebooking option or a documented no-contact reason.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets salon rebooking system, spa rebooking follow up, client rebooking tracker, and salon retention workflow searches.

products.name: Service Room Par Tracker
products.product: A focused salon and spa room inventory par tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent salons, spas, and small wellness studios
products.problem: Back-bar and treatment-room supplies run out between formal inventory counts because usage, room transfers, and replenishment ownership are not visible at the service level.
products.valueProposition: Turns salon and spa room inventory par tracking into a visible operating queue so each service room is replenished to an agreed par before its next booked service without hiding inventory variance.
products.topic: salon and spa room inventory par tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets salon back bar inventory, spa room stock checklist, treatment room par levels, and salon supply tracker searches.
